description: CAT-V, Recordset.Requery() with no argument after a real parameter change (the first card set the value it already had). A saved parameter select QP (pV Long) is reached through a QueryDef; a dynaset and a snapshot are opened with pV = 20 and read; pV is set to 40 on the same QueryDef instance and each recordset gets Requery() (Errors before/after) and is read again; then qd.SQL is put with a different WHERE and Requery() is called once more; finally a recordset opened afresh from the QueryDef is read. Asks whether Requery() re-binds the current parameter value, the old one, or the new SQL.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
